The beige exterior presents a clean, sophisticated appearance that stands out while remaining timeless. The panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the Head-Up Display keeps essential information visible without diverting your attention from the road. Driver's Seat Memory adapts to your preferences automatically, ensuring consistent comfort every time you drive.  Climate control extends throughout the cabin with front dual-zone automatic temperature adjustment, heated front seats, ventilated front seats for warm weather, and heated rear seats for passenger comfort. The heated leather steering wheel and available rear window defroster prepare you for weather challenges, while rain-sensing wipers respond automatically to changing conditions.  Safety integration includes front and rear parking assist with automated braking, exterior parking camera, dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, overhead airbags, and emergency communication through Safety Connect. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, anti-lock brakes, and four-wheel independent suspension provide confident handling and stopping power.  The 120V power outlet in the cargo area lets you power tools and devices on the job, while the power liftgate opens hands-free with foot activation. The split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs, whether hauling supplies or passengers.
